headline: Continental Shanghai Thwarts Email Attack, Minimizes Shipping Delays
body: Continental Automotive Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. recently contained a business email compromise incident. This minor cyber disruption affected order-entry systems and shipping notifications, but operations faced only brief delays. The Shanghai division emphasized that no core production systems were encrypted and functional flow remained stable. As the company adjusts protocols, it assures partners minimal impact on logistics timelines.
